# Location scope. True when the location belongs to a historical region that already hosts a theme.
# trigger_if keeps the right-hand variable from being read on locations outside every region (UI lists evaluate every location).
oe_theme_region_has_theme = {
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_theme_region }
        save_temporary_scope_as = oe_tr_loc
        c:BYZ = { any_owned_location = { var:oe_theme_region ?= scope:oe_tr_loc.var:oe_theme_region oe_theme_location_occupied_trigger = yes } }
    }
    trigger_else = { always = no }
}
